{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))

# Check if they are completed or refunded
print("Status of QA orders:", qa_orders['status'].value_counts())

# Also check if they are in the loyal segment
print("Customer segment of QA orders:", qa_orders['customer_segment'].value_counts())"}
